39/G.goal: Explain how object interaction in immersive experience design is organized into selection and manipulation, and describe the main techniques and criteria for choosing them.
39/G.achieves: Prepares the learner to specify and evaluate object-interaction features in the system-design stage of building an XR system.

39/O1.goal: Explain the broad categories of interaction in immersive experience design.
39/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a framework for distinguishing object interaction, navigation, and system control when specifying the interaction requirements of an XR experience.

39/O2.goal: Describe object selection techniques and the parameters used to choose among them.
39/O2.achieves: Lets the learner evaluate and select suitable hand-based, pointing-based, image-plane, and volumetric techniques for selecting virtual objects in an XR system.

39/O3.goal: Describe object manipulation techniques, including hand-based, indirect, bimanual, and integrated hybrid approaches.
39/O3.achieves: Lets the learner assess methods for changing a virtual object's position, orientation, scale, shape, or behavior when designing XR interaction.
